choices: Concatenates all stream elements into a single String separated by ', '
Splits a String into a Stream
explanation: Collectors.joining(delimiter) concatenates String stream elements with the delimiter between them. Stream.of("a","b","c").collect(Collectors.joining(", ")) → "a, b, c". Can also take prefix and suffix: joining(", ", "[", "]") → "[a, b, c]".
